description_en: Triggers a single evaluation of the rule
description_zh: 使该规则执行一次评估
name: StartConfigRuleEvaluation

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run. The system checks the request parameters and business logic without performing the actual operation. If the dry run succeeds, the DryRunOperation error code is returned. If the dry run fails, the corresponding error code is returned.
false: performs the actual operation. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否仅预检本次请求。取值：

true：执行请求参数及相关业务校验，不执行实际操作。预检通过时返回错误码 DryRunOperation；预检失败时返回对应错误码。
false（默认值）：正常执行请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can generate the value from your client. Make sure that the value is unique across different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the rule.

For more information about how to obtain the rule ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.help_zh:
规则ID。

关于如何获取规则ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/169607.html
parameters.name: config_rule_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to restore ignored evaluation results. Valid values:

true: restores ignored evaluation results.

false: does not restore ignored evaluation results
parameters.help_zh:
是否恢复已忽略的评估结果。取值：

true：恢复已忽略的评估结果。

false：不恢复已忽略的评估结果
parameters.name: revert_evaluation

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html.

You must specify either the CompliancePackId or ConfigRuleId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html。

参数`CompliancePackId`和`ConfigRuleId`必须二选一
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

Result.description_en:
The execution result of the rule. Valid values:

true: The execution succeeded.

false: The execution failed
Result.description_zh:
规则执行结果。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
